name: Chat On Steroids
use_label: ChatGPT that edits your local files
one_liner: Lets a ChatGPT chat edit your files, run tests and use your desktop.

text.why: Working on code through ChatGPT means pasting files in and copying results back out. Chat On Steroids pairs a desktop app with a Chrome extension so the chat can read and edit files in folders you approve, run tests and keep terminals open. Independent jobs can be split across workers, and Compact & Resume carries a session into a fresh chat. It uses your ChatGPT conversation rather than Codex quota, under MIT, though the builds are still an unsigned beta.
text.take: A side door: local coding work on your ChatGPT plan, without touching Codex quota.
build: A personal coding setup that fixes a local repo on a ChatGPT plan alone
A parallel workflow that splits independent jobs across workers
A hand-off routine that carries a long task into a new chat

who.situation: wants local file work done without Codex
wants a long task split across several workers

start.text: Download the Windows, macOS (Apple silicon) or Linux build from Releases
Approve your project folder in Settings → Workspace
Connect Core via Settings → Setup and add it in ChatGPT's Developer mode
Open the extension folder and Load unpacked in Chrome; pairing is automatic
Choose a model, write your task and send

caveat: Windows build is unsigned and macOS unnotarized; verify checksums
Needs a ChatGPT account with Developer mode and custom MCP apps
Not affiliated with OpenAI, as the README states

license.scope_text: Use, change and redistribute, commercially too. Keep the notice.

numbers.star_delta_unit: GitHub stars gained in the window, GH Archive events summed to as_of
numbers.method: Star total = the value last checked on GitHub (stars_checked_at) + increases observed via GH Archive since. The 24h · 7d · 30d gains are GH Archive hourly events summed to the reference time (as_of). No score of ours.
